title: Wood tower shield

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Wood tower shield is the first tower shield. It has four more block armor and 80 more block force compared to Wood shield but reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10%.
As a tower shield, it cannot be used to parry enemy attacks.

full_text:
Wood tower shield

Internal ID: ShieldWoodTower | Type: Shield | Source: Workbench | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Wood x10, Leather scraps x6 | Movement speed: -10%

Introduction. The Wood tower shield is the first tower shield. It has four more block armor and 80 more block force compared to Wood shield but reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10%.
As a tower shield, it cannot be used to parry enemy attacks.

Upgrade information. Cost to max is 25 wood and 15 leather scraps.

Notes. • When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
